title: Gunman Kills One and Wounds Four in Logan Circle Gym Shooting in Washington
dek: A gunman opened fire at a gym in Washington’s Logan Circle neighborhood on Thursday morning, killing one man and wounding four others before he died in an apartment building, police said.
author: Meridian Newsroom

image.alt: Aerial view of Logan Circle in Washington, D.C.
image.credit: Carol M. Highsmith, via Wikimedia Commons

keyPoints: Police said a gunman opened fire inside the VIDA Fitness gym in Logan Circle shortly after 8 a.m., killing one man and wounding four others, then barricaded himself in a nearby apartment building.
Police identified the gunman as Matt Lambert, a 55-year-old emergency room doctor who had sued his condominium association over mold, CNN reported. He died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

Interim Chief Jeff Carroll said one of the wounded remains in critical condition. The man killed was identified by police as James Stuart, 46, building manager of the condominium where the gunman lived.
Residents were told to shelter in place until about 11:30 a.m., NPR reported.
body:
A gunman opened fire at a VIDA Fitness gym in Washington’s Logan Circle neighborhood on Thursday morning, killing one man and wounding four others before he barricaded himself in a nearby condominium building. He died there of a self-inflicted gunshot wound, police said.

## What police said

The first call for help came in at 8 a.m., and officers were on scene within 30 seconds, Interim Metropolitan Police Chief Jeff Carroll told reporters, [NPR reported](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038860/dc-logan-circle-shooting). Carroll said the attack took less than five minutes, according to [CNN’s live coverage](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/12/us/live-news/washington-dc-shooting).

Police said the gunman first shot one man inside the gym. Carroll identified that man as James Stuart, 46, who was the building manager of the condominium where the suspect lived. CNN reported that police said the gunman then went to his seventh-floor apartment and fired with a rifle at four other victims from his balcony. NPR, citing Carroll, gave a different account of where the four were wounded: three were shot at a nearby construction site and one in the lobby or alley area of the building. Meridian is noting that discrepancy because the two accounts were not reconciled in the reports reviewed.

Police said they had “some information” that the gunman may also have fired a shotgun before going to the gym, but that details were still being worked through. They also said he set a fire inside his apartment, possibly with accelerant, and that he had no firearms registered in the District.

## The gunman

Police identified the gunman as Matt Lambert, a 55-year-old emergency room doctor, CNN reported. In March 2025 he sued the Metropole Condominium Association, alleging that maintenance work had caused water and mold damage in his penthouse unit. Carroll described him to NPR as a white man who had a conflict with the building’s homeowners association.

## Response and the neighborhood

Residents were sent emergency alerts telling them to stay sheltered in place. NPR reported that the order was lifted around 11:30 a.m. The FBI Washington Field Office said it was assisting the Metropolitan Police Department and Metro Transit Police at the scene on the 1500 block of 15th Street NW. Mayor Muriel Bowser and D.C. Fire and EMS Chief John Donnelly also briefed the public.

Logan Circle sits about a mile north of the White House, in a neighborhood of apartment buildings, shops and restaurants. Police said one victim remains in critical condition.
